item.title: The Daily FIX, Tuesday 24 November 2026
item.description: Morning. It's the Daily FIX for Tuesday the twenty fourth of November. The big one today is fuel. The fuel cost recovery rules for trucking are back in force, starting today. Diesel's down almost nineteen cents a litre on a month ago. And on the roads, no unplanned closures on any interstate lane. Queensland's the slow one. In this episode: Yesterday in the industry, Overnight on the main lanes, Rail, Weather and fire, Planned closures.
